vb_textbox.text: There are two different groups of gnomes. There are the natural coloured ones and the unnatural coloured ones. Gnomes in a group will have similar mushroom amounts that you can collect. These change as the rounds progress. It is best to check these during 1x multipliers to minimise losses. Stick with one that is giving high amounts of mushrooms until it stops, then switch and see if you earn more. Good luck!!
